# Cursor changelog — captured 2026-08-21
# https://cursor.com/changelog  (sources.json URL is CORRECT for the changelog;
#  only docs.cursor.com is wrong — it 308s to cursor.com/docs)
# Tier: watching — "only report major new capabilities"

### August 19, 2026 — NEW THIS SCAN. Cloud Agents + Cursor Harness
- **Subscriptions** — agents monitor **PRs, Slack threads and scheduled tasks**. Agents
  **automatically subscribe to PRs they create and drive them to completion.**
- **Custom Modes** — "always on" skills that keep agents focused on specific tasks.
- **Subagents on isolated machines** — each subagent runs in its own virtual environment with a
  clean project copy.
- **Goal tracking** — `/goal` assigns long-lived objectives agents work toward independently.
- **Non-interruptive steering** — guidance sent mid-run QUEUES for the next tool call rather than
  halting execution.
  => agent activity becomes continuous and event-triggered, not session-bounded; the meaningful
     inventory is active SUBSCRIPTIONS and GOALS, not "agents". Slack-thread monitoring puts an
     agent with repo access on a channel carrying untrusted text.
                                                            [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM/AISPM]

### August 17, 2026 — NEW THIS SCAN. *** CURSOR IS NOW A CODE HOST ***
- **Cursor Origin** — "Origin is Cursor's git forge for storing and sharing code" (early beta).
  Repository creation, standard git ops (clone/push/pull), code browsing and search at
  **cursor.com/codebase**, PR review and merge. Existing projects onboarded by **GitHub mirroring**.
  **PRs on synced repos sync BOTH WAYS** — comment in Cursor and it posts to GitHub; react or reply
  on GitHub and it appears in Cursor within seconds.
  Integrations: **Vercel, Depot, Buildkite** for deploys/CI-CD, plus automations, cloud agents, and
  an **Origin CLI**.
  Access: Pro, Teams and Enterprise. Team admins grant repo access once a codebase namespace is
  claimed. **Teams on legacy privacy mode CANNOT enable Origin** — must switch to Privacy Mode first.
  Privacy follows each namespace owner's Privacy Mode configuration.
  => this is not an agent feature; it is a NEW LOCATION WHERE CUSTOMER SOURCE CODE LIVES, outside
     the sanctioned SCM, and bidirectional PR sync moves code review off the governed platform.
                                                            [reported 2026-08-21, HIGH/AISPM]
  https://cursor.com/docs/origin

### August 13, 2026
- Cloud Agents start 3x faster with **builds** (pre-built environment snapshots, resilient fallback
  to last successful build, build history + debugging in the dashboard).   [held 2026-08-14]

### August 3, 2026
- **Google Workspace plugins** — agents get direct access to Gmail, Google Drive and Google Calendar
  for managing files, email and schedules within Cursor.                  [previously captured]

Updated: 2026-08-21 — two new dated entries. Origin (code hosting) is the first Cursor item to clear
the watching-tier bar as a HIGH, because it changes where code lives rather than what the IDE can do.
</content>
